name: 2+C
purpose: Target 2+0 fast-path throughput while conditionally spending a third round only when the first two center frames disagree.
state_machine: Run acquisition rounds R1 and R2.
Any center flag or detected ancilla loss in R1/R2 -> HOLD.
Any detected data loss in R1/R2 -> QUARANTINE.
If complete center frames b1 and b2 are identical, recover using that frame and ACCEPT immediately; do not execute R3.
If b1 != b2 and neither round flagged/lost, execute one conditional resolver round R3.
Any center flag or detected ancilla loss in R3 -> HOLD; detected data loss -> QUARANTINE.
If b3 exactly equals b1 or b2 as a complete four-bit frame, select the repeated frame, apply the frozen Pauli-frame decoder, and ACCEPT.
If b3 matches neither complete frame, HOLD.
No terminal post-recovery verification round is executed in this version.
ambiguity_condition: b1 != b2 with both mandatory round records complete, unflagged, and loss-free
resolver_rule: whole-frame exact repeat; no bitwise synthetic majority when b3 matches neither b1 nor b2
recovery: same candidate-basis to frozen-center coordinate map and frozen ideal-center decoder as parent benchmark

fault_semantics.p: same frozen independent Bernoulli quantum-location rate and conditional Pauli distributions
fault_semantics.q: same frozen binary measurement-bit flip rate
fault_semantics.conditional_round_exposure: R3 fault locations exist only on trajectories that satisfy the ambiguity condition after R1/R2
fault_semantics.unexecuted_R3_locations: zero exposure and cannot host faults

resources.expected_resources: must be reported from the stochastic trajectory distribution; cannot use the fixed 3-round maximum as actual average

evaluation_freeze.single_event: exact exhaustive over mandatory R1/R2 locations; R3 has no single-event-only locations because a clean mandatory prefix does not trigger R3
evaluation_freeze.two_event: exact exhaustive over (mandatory,mandatory) pairs plus (triggering mandatory event, conditional-R3 event) pairs; two R3-only faults are impossible at total order two
evaluation_freeze.higher_order: exact <=2 contribution plus conservative maximum-3-round tail enclosure and frozen Monte Carlo conditional on adaptive execution

stop_rules: Do not change the whole-frame exact-repeat rule after exposure.
Do not replace it with bitwise majority after exposure within v0.1.
Do not add a post-recovery verification round after exposure within v0.1.
Any adaptive successor is a new candidate.
This post-exposure candidate cannot retroactively alter the frozen 1+0/2+1/3+1 benchmark.
